questions.q: What is defined as the introduction of harmful substances or contaminants into the environment that cause adverse changes?
Which of the following is a major source of air pollution in urban centers?
a: Exhaust fumes from vehicles and industrial smoke

questions.q: What term is used for waste materials such as plastic bags, bottles, and electronic gadgets that do not decay easily in the environment?
Which of the following practices is an effective way to manage solid waste and reduce environmental pollution?
a: Burning all plastic waste in open fields
Leaving garbage uncollected in public areas
The 3 Rs: Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle

questions.q: What is water pollution?
a: Contamination of water bodies such as rivers, lakes, and oceans with harmful chemicals, sewage, or plastics
The natural evaporation of water into the atmosphere
The boiling of water to kill germs
The filtration of drinking water through sand

questions.q: Which of the following agricultural practices contributes significantly to water pollution when washed into rivers?
a: Excessive use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides

questions.q: What environmental problem is caused by the excessive release of greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide into the atmosphere?
Which type of pollution is caused by excessive, unwanted, or disturbing sounds from heavy machinery, traffic, and loud music?
What is the primary danger of improper disposal of electronic waste (e-waste) containing heavy metals like lead and mercury?
a: Contamination of soil and underground water sources
Immediate cooling of the local climate

questions.q: Which of the following is a direct consequence of land pollution caused by indiscriminate dumping of refuse?
a: Breeding ground for disease vectors like mosquitoes, rats, and flies

questions.q: What term describes organic waste materials that can be easily broken down by microorganisms into harmless substances?
Which method involves converting used waste materials like glass, paper, and metal into new useful products?
What is the main environmental impact of acid rain resulting from sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxide emissions?
a: Damage to aquatic life in lakes, corrosion of buildings, and destruction of forests

questions.q: Which of the following actions best demonstrates the principle of 'Reduce' in waste management?
a: Throwing away plastic bags after single use
Buying goods with minimal packaging and avoiding single-use plastics

questions.q: What health problem is most commonly associated with chronic exposure to high levels of air pollution and smoke?
a: Respiratory diseases such as asthma and bronchitis

questions.q: Which of the following practices helps prevent soil erosion and land degradation?
a: Overgrazing by livestock on steep slopes
Planting trees (afforestation and re-afforestation) and contour farming

questions.q: What is sewage pollution in aquatic ecosystems?
a: Discharge of untreated human and household waste water into rivers and seas

questions.q: Which of the following is a renewable energy source that helps reduce air pollution caused by burning fossil fuels?
What term refers to a substance that contaminates the environment, making it unclean or unsafe?
Why is the use of non-biodegradable polythene bags a major environmental concern in many communities?
a: They dissolve instantly in rain water
They provide valuable nutrients to soil bacteria
They persist in the environment for hundreds of years, clogging drains and littering land

questions.q: What preventive measure can industries adopt to minimize toxic liquid waste pollution?
a: Treating effluent wastewater in treatment plants before discharging it
Pumping untreated chemicals directly into open gutters
Diluting waste with drinking water supplies
Burying liquid waste in shallow pits near homes

questions.q: Which of the following is an effect of noise pollution on human health?
a: Stress, sleep disturbance, and hearing impairment

questions.q: What is composting used for in organic waste management?
a: Converting organic kitchen and garden waste into nutrient-rich manure for soil

questions.q: Which government or community action helps reduce vehicular air pollution in cities?
a: Promoting public transport, vehicle emission testing, and fuel efficiency standards

questions.q: What is the environmental danger of oil spills in oceans and coastal waters?
a: Suffocation and poisoning of marine life, birds, and destruction of coastal ecosystems

questions.q: Which of the following activities promotes pollution prevention at home?
a: Pouring used engine oil down the kitchen drain
Segregating household waste into organic and plastic bins for recycling
Burning plastic containers in the backyard
Leaving electrical appliances on standby continuously

questions.q: What is the term for the depletion of the protective ozone layer in the stratosphere, which shields Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation?
Which of the following describes the 'Reuse' practice in environmental management?
a: Melting down metal cans into raw blocks
Using glass jars or durable shopping bags multiple times instead of throwing them away

questions.q: What negative effect does littering plastic waste in gutters have during rainy seasons?
a: Blocking drainage systems and causing severe localized floods

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of biological pollution or biological contamination in water?
a: Pathogenic bacteria, viruses, and parasites from untreated sewage

questions.q: What environmental management strategy involves planting trees on land where forests have been depleted?
Why should burning of agricultural crop residues (like straw and husks) in open fields be minimized?
a: It increases soil moisture too much
It produces heavy smoke and air pollution that affects visibility and health
